## About

PhD Applied Microeconomist with expertise in environmental economics, health economics, empirical industrial organization, and labor economics. Skilled in causal inference, market and non-market valuation, hedonic methods, consumer demand modeling, and big data analysis. Proven ability to combine public and proprietary data with economic theory to derive insights into firm, regulator, and consumer behavior. Seeking roles in economic consulting, research, teaching, economic strategy, and tech.

## Research Interests

- Regulation
- Environmental economics
- Critical minerals
- Health economics
- Climate change and productivity
- Water quality
